surfaces.condition: A material feature, functionality, behavior, CLI/API, workflow, data, integration, security/privacy, or quality/release change is added or changed.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with affected surfaces, contracts, documentation, tests, evidence, owners, and projections.
For a purely internal refactor or isolated fix with no matrix impact, record a reviewed no-impact reason in the same change record; omission is not an implicit no-impact decision.

surfaces.path: src/, tests/, scripts/, and packaged assets
surfaces.condition: CLI, packet, batch, validation, or artifact behavior changes
validation: uv run basedpyright src tests scripts

surfaces.path: installed rdw CLI and research-domain-writing skill projections
surfaces.condition: public command, packaged asset, adapter, or skill contract changes
Intent, source ownership or evidence oracle associations change.
validation: Review source-grounding and human-review boundaries; run affected source-bound proof and authoritative QR; preserve installed provider and consumer enforcement gaps.
surfaces.reviewed_impact: Compass metadata plus narrow canonical DOI-document projection repair. Bytecode executable-line classification preserves actual trace counts; tests/test_pre_cr_python_coverage.py distinguishes constant tuple continuations, executed lines and an uncovered executable branch.
